# CalcTree

> CalcTree is an engineering calculation platform. A page holds prose plus calculation blocks; the blocks form a calculation graph that evaluates server-side with real units. This repo is the single source of truth for driving CalcTree programmatically from outside the platform.

Read the skill first. It is the verified, current account of how to create and read
calculation pages, and it supersedes any older CalcTree API documentation.

## Start here

- [CalcTree skill](skills/building-calctree-calculations/SKILL.md): auth, the write path, MDX calculation syntax, formula rules, and the authoring rules that decide whether a generated page reads correctly.

## Working code

- [Primitives](skills/building-calctree-calculations/scripts/calctree-api.ts): page creation with tree registration, MDX content insert, calculation writes, page context reads, cross-page references.
- [End-to-end example](skills/building-calctree-calculations/examples/smoke-two-page.ts): creates two linked pages and reads the computed values back.

## Notes

- One `x-api-key` covers reads, page creation and content writes. An invalid key surfaces as a bare `"Unexpected error."`.
- A page must be registered in the page tree or it is orphaned and invisible.
- Evaluation is asynchronous: settle about two seconds after a write before reading.
